summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a 6-K attaching a September 23, 2026 news release announcing an application to the Alberta Securities Commission over Curaleaf's hostile bid. Aurora's board and Special Committee unanimously recommend shareholders REJECT and NOT TENDER, citing Curaleaf's Circular deficiencies: missing pro-forma financials, failure to hold the minimum 105-day deposit period, and no French-language notice. Aurora argues the bid is not a permitted bid under its Shareholder Rights Plan, triggered above 20% ownership. No price, premium, or advisor is disclosed; watch ASC rulings and bid extension mechanics.
